authority: native AIENOS capability authority (C); Linux stand-in not started
seat_body: qualified 32-bit integer add (IADD3), A.field0 + A.field1 -> B.field0
hardware_scope: one persistent graphics seat on the machine's own chip, same image as the processor

scenarios.name: chain A -> chip add -> B -> processor -> C
duplicate completion is not published twice
torn result notice is refused and B is restored
seat restart keeps identity and history
capability revoked after the claim is refused at publication
generation moved in flight invalidates the chip's work
stale generation claim is refused on the chip
seat killed holding a claim: recorded, restored, released once, retried

seat_loss.kill_method: host destroys the running channel group; not a chip-raised fault

not_exercised: recovery from a chip-raised fault (MMU fault, Xid) rather than a host-initiated channel teardown
seat lost before its first heartbeat
